answer: Lock work history behind time and publish failures. Every completed task adds a timestamped entry, and every failed audit publishes the identity and the reason. Idle agents bleed standing each epoch. A farm cannot backfill a year of entries in a week, and one published failure marks the whole cluster. Cost: 1,000 identities need 1,000 real work histories, roughly 365 entries each, before a jury treats them as senior. An atlas of addresses is not an atlas of work, a relic of a reputation does not transfer, and bots that wander between hosts carry the same public record.
